description:
Owner only: add or remove an account's credits, as POST
    /v1/admin/accounts/{account_id}/credits. A change that would take the balance below
    zero is 422 credits_below_zero and nothing changes; an unknown account is 404
    account_not_found. Every change is audited (admin_list_actions). Returns {account_id,
    credits, delta}.

delta.description: credits to add (positive) or remove (negative), -1000000 to 1000000, not zero
delta.title: Delta

note.description: why, for the audit: 1 to 200 characters, required
note.title: Note

name: admin_adjust_credits
